text.p: Bonds were edging higher in thin morning trade, with business in the futures contract halted by technical problems.
Traders said that the market was waiting for preliminary June inflation figures from five Italian cities due at 1530 GMT which should give an indication to direction of Italian BTPs.

But some traders said that even if the Italian inflation figures were encouraging, the peripheries might not react very much. Good figures would give additional support but prices were unlikely to gain significantly, they said.
There was little activity at the shorter end and the longer end did not appear to have much immediate upside, traders added.
"The futures and the cash gained a little, taking advantage of the firmness elsewhere in Europe and the steady escudo but the gains could be limited," said one trader.
"The 10-years are now at 60 basis points (to Bunds) and this could be a difficult level to break today," added another.
